circuits.name: age_verification
circuits.description: Proves user age >= minAge without revealing birthYear
useCases: Gate an 18+ product without collecting date of birth
Prove age eligibility to a KYC flow while keeping the birth year private

circuits.name: anonymous_vote
circuits.description: Cast a private vote in {0..7} as a member of a depth-16 Poseidon Merkle tree of eligible voters; emit a per-(voter, ballot) nullifier so each voter votes at most once
useCases: One-person-one-vote ballots where the voter stays anonymous
DAO governance votes with double-vote protection via nullifiers

voterSecret.description: Voter's secret. leaf = Poseidon(voterSecret) lives in the voters tree

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

vote.description: Chosen option, in [0, 8). Re-emitted as the public output revealedVote

votersRoot.description: Public Merkle root of all eligible voters

ballotId.description: Identifier of this ballot. Namespaces the nullifier so voters can re-vote in future ballots

nullifier.description: Poseidon(voterSecret, ballotId). Tally contract must reject duplicates

revealedVote.description: The vote in {0..7}, exposed publicly so the tally contract can count it

circuits.name: country_allowlist
circuits.description: Prove your committed country code is one of the countries in a depth-8 Poseidon Merkle allowlist, without revealing which
useCases: Prove residency in an allowed country without revealing which one
Geo-compliance gates for regulated products

salt.description: Random salt that hides the country in the public commitment

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes on the way from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

commitment.description: Poseidon(countryCode, salt). Pre-committed so the holder cannot change country mid-flight

allowlistRoot.description: Merkle root of allowed countries (leaf = Poseidon(countryCode))

circuits.name: eddsa_credential_check
circuits.description: Verifies an issuer's Baby Jubjub EdDSA signature over Poseidon(subject, claim) without revealing the subject; emits a per-context nullifier
useCases: Prove possession of an issuer-signed credential without showing it
Selective disclosure of verified attributes

subject.description: Holder identity that the issuer signed off on

claim.description: Public statement the issuer attested to (e.g. Poseidon("isAdult"))

issuerAx.description: Baby Jubjub x coordinate of the issuer's public key

issuerAy.description: Baby Jubjub y coordinate of the issuer's public key

contextId.description: Application / session identifier; namespaces the nullifier

nullifier.description: Poseidon(subject, contextId). Use to detect credential reuse

circuits.name: geofence_proof
circuits.description: Prove a private (lat, lng) lies inside a public rectangular bounding box without revealing the exact point. Coordinates use 32-bit fixed-point: lat = round((lat_deg + 90) * 1e6), lng = round((lng_deg + 180) * 1e6)
useCases: Prove presence inside a geographic bounding box without exact coordinates
Location-gated drops that never learn where the user is

latMin.description: Inclusive minimum encoded latitude of the geofence

latMax.description: Inclusive maximum encoded latitude of the geofence

lngMin.description: Inclusive minimum encoded longitude of the geofence

lngMax.description: Inclusive maximum encoded longitude of the geofence

circuits.name: hidden_bid_validity
circuits.description: Sealed-bid auction primitive: prove a private bid opens a public Poseidon commitment and is within a published [minBid, maxBid] range
useCases: Sealed-bid auctions: prove a bid is within bounds without revealing it
Commit-reveal bidding with validity guarantees

salt.description: Random salt that hides the bid in the commitment

commitment.description: Poseidon(bid, salt) published before the auction reveal phase

minBid.description: Inclusive lower bound the bid must satisfy

maxBid.description: Inclusive upper bound the bid must satisfy

circuits.name: merkle_membership
circuits.description: Proves a private leaf is included in a public Poseidon-2 Merkle tree of depth 8 without revealing the leaf or its path
useCases: Prove an address is on an allowlist without revealing which entry
Anonymous group membership checks against a published Merkle root

leaf.description: The secret leaf whose inclusion is being proven

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes along the path from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = leaf is left child, 1 = leaf is right child), bottom-up

root.description: Public Merkle root the leaf claims membership in

circuits.name: poseidon_preimage
circuits.description: Proves knowledge of a field element x such that Poseidon([x]) == hash
useCases: Prove knowledge of a committed secret without revealing it
Smallest possible building block for commit-reveal schemes

preimage.description: Secret preimage; any element of the bn128 scalar field

hash.description: Poseidon([preimage]) — the public commitment being opened

circuits.name: private_balance_threshold
circuits.description: Proves a private balance is at least a public threshold, anchored to a public Poseidon commitment of (balance, salt)
useCases: Prove a balance clears a minimum without revealing the amount
Collateral checks for lending flows with private balances

balance.description: Account balance in any 64-bit denominated unit

salt.description: Random salt mixed into the commitment to prevent rainbow attacks

threshold.description: Public threshold the prover claims their balance is at least equal to

circuits.name: private_transfer
circuits.description: Tornado-style shielded spend: prove a Poseidon commitment is in a depth-16 Merkle tree of UTXOs, emit a single-use nullifier, bound to a public recipient address
useCases: Shielded value transfer with balance conservation
Private payment notes with double-spend protection

secret.description: Spending key half: leaf = Poseidon(secret, nullifierSeed)

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

root.description: Public Merkle root of all live UTXO commitments

recipient.description: Recipient address packed into a field element. Bound into the proof to prevent withdraw-front-running

circuits.name: range_proof_64bit
circuits.description: Canonical 64-bit range proof: prove a private value x in [0, 2^64) that opens a public Poseidon commitment. Designed to be reused as a building block
useCases: Prove a committed value fits in 64 bits and within a range
Reusable range constraint for financial circuits

x.description: Value being range-checked (must fit in 64 bits)

salt.description: Random salt that hides x in the public commitment

commitment.description: Poseidon(x, salt) anchored on-chain or in a registry

circuits.name: sha256_preimage_short
circuits.description: Prove SHA256(preimage) == hash for a fixed 32-byte preimage. Both preimage and digest are split into two 128-bit halves so they fit in BN128 field elements; this matches Solidity's bytes32 layout
useCases: Prove knowledge of a SHA-256 preimage without revealing it
Bridge commitments from SHA-256-based systems into ZK

hashHigh.description: Most-significant 128 bits of the SHA256 digest

hashLow.description: Least-significant 128 bits of the SHA256 digest

circuits.name: solvency_attestation
circuits.description: N=16 proof of reserves: prove sum of 16 Poseidon-committed balances meets a public threshold, without revealing individual balances
useCases: Prove assets exceed liabilities without publishing the books
Exchange proof-of-solvency attestations

commitments.description: Per-account Poseidon([balance, salt]) commitments published in advance

threshold.description: Required minimum sum of balances (constrained to 64 bits)

circuits.name: unique_human_nullifier
circuits.description: Proof of personhood: prove your private secret is in a depth-16 Poseidon Merkle tree of registered humans, and emit a deterministic per-app nullifier so the same human can perform the gated action at most once per app
useCases: One-account-per-person signups resistant to sybil attacks
Derive an app-scoped nullifier from a personhood credential

secret.description: Holder's secret. leaf = Poseidon(secret) lives in the registered-humans tree

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

humansRoot.description: Public Merkle root of all registered humans

appId.description: App / context identifier; the nullifier is namespaced by it

nullifier.description: Poseidon(secret, appId). Spend once per app to prevent Sybil
